combined_weighting: all archived virtual cells, not equal band means
cosine_definition: all predicted x measured cell pairs; pairs are not independent
gene_panel_leakage: archived KO/control DEG-informed fixed evaluation panel
DQN_role: KO-informed reference only, excluded from independent predictor ranking

scGen.training_provenance: Official scgen.SCGEN 2.1.1; scvi DataSplitter adapter enforces common train/valid indices; ATF6-control latent arithmetic uses training cells only.

CPA.training_provenance: Official cpa.CPA; common train/valid split; counterfactual X contains held-out control expression, target condition ATF6.

CellOracle.training_provenance: Official CellOracle; public hg38 promoter prior; GRN/PCA fitted on training control only. Query imputed from 30 training-control neighbors; simulated_count is log1p CP10K because imported raw_count is full-library CP10K. No KO expression used.
CellOracle.compatibility_adapter: Cap CV quality-control rank at eligible control-expressed genes to prevent upstream IndexError; does not filter or change the 2000-gene panel.

shared_split.population: 1715 control and 1202 archived Validation 2 KO cells; other KO cells excluded
shared_split.panel_limit: Panel selected using full KO/control labels; not independent gene selection

run_metadata.state_space: continuous virtual latent coordinates generated by actions (no coordinate graph, not cells)
run_metadata.start: 3x_neg_ctrl_pMJ144-1: saved section 5–6 z_start (inverse PCA of control PCA median)
run_metadata.density: arrival-coordinate visits (steps >= 1), including repeated visits, on the fixed UMAP
run_metadata.actions: +/- each of 128 latent axes x strides [1] = 256
run_metadata.base_substep: 0.01 x observed SD per latent axis
run_metadata.support_constraint: every sub-step 5th-NN observed-cell distance <= 0.182443 (q0.95); 0 <= arrival ATF6 < current ATF6
run_metadata.decrease_check: arrival versus recorded current ATF6; reduction > 8 * dtype epsilon * max(abs(current), 1)
run_metadata.state_features: latent, shared-start displacement, ATF6, observational entropy, radius, elapsed fraction
run_metadata.entropy: Shannon H of decoded expression p=expm1(max(decoder(z),0))/sum (nats)

stop_rule.rule: simulation: low net movement, horizon, or no supported ATF6-decreasing action; training: horizon or no decreasing action

clustering.method: Ward hierarchical on 3-phase net latent displacement (observed-SD units)
clustering.k_selection: silhouette elbow: largest k before the silhouette drops by > 0.1 (else first k with next gain < 0.25 x largest gain)

run_metadata.interpretation: Fixed-VAE model trajectories, not causal KO or validated differentiation.

sampling_metadata.gaussian: Uniform mixture over DQN arrival latent coordinates; diagonal covariance (sigma_observed_sd_fraction * observed latent SD)^2
sampling_metadata.density: Bilinear interpolation of section 14 peak-normalized Gaussian-smoothed UMAP visit density, not a density percentile
sampling_metadata.expression: Full original VAE decoder output clamped at zero in log1p CP10K space; select 1994 ranked non-required + six required genes. Actual KO uses measured adata.X, not VAE reconstruction.
sampling_metadata.interpretation: Model-based sampled KO-like expression; not evidence of causal KO accuracy.
